import{readdir,readFile}from'node:fs/promises';import{homedir,tmpdir}from'node:os';import{join}from'node:path';let total=0,alive=0;const pids=new Set();for(const d of[join(homedir(),'.opencut'),join(tmpdir(),'opencut')]){const paths=[join(d,'mcp-classic-bridge.json'),...(await readdir(join(d,'mcp-classic-bridges')).catch(()=>[])).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json')).map(x=>join(d,'mcp-classic-bridges',x))];for(const p of paths){try{const c=JSON.parse(await readFile(p,'utf8'));total++;try{process.kill(c.pid,0);alive++;pids.add(c.pid)}catch{}}catch{}}}console.log({total,alive,pids:[...pids]})
